runtimes.value: mflux (~12-14 s per 1024 image on M5 Max, mflux#817); ComfyUI native (docs tutorial; a Dec 2025 Mac garbage-output report #11231 was solved by a fresh Python env; 399 s per image on a 24 GB M5 at launch per HN); Draw Things (since 1.20251207.0, imported models run in BF16 since May 2026); stable-diffusion.cpp (Metal, Comfy-Org or GGUF); DiffSynth-Studio; diffusers ZImagePipeline (worked on a Mac per #11231)
runtimes.note: The diffusers-on-Mac evidence is one comment in #11231. Device used there not stated explicitly.

web.scope: Searched on 13.11.2026. Sources: Hacker News comments, Hugging Face discussions, issues of mflux, ComfyUI, mlx-video and ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper. **Reddit could not be read**; blogs and developers promoting their own engines are leads only. Released 27.11.2025; window: launch thread plus 13.05–13.11.2026.
web.summary: Still a favourite a year later; fast on an M5 Max with recent mflux; occasional missing letters.
web.verdict: Still a favourite; ~13 s/image on M5 Max 128 GB (mflux); occasionally drops a letter

comments.text: Weak outside photo portraits, showing how limited it is ([AuryGlenz, 17.01.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46655687)); drifts to Chinese people and text with context ([reactordev, 06.12.2025](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46176963)).
Text good, but occasionally drops a letter ([accrual, 07.12.2025](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46178360)).
Slow on Macs at launch: 399 s per image on a 24 GB M5 MacBook Pro in ComfyUI ([aleyan, 06.12.2025](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46176998)).

Has replaced one user's stock photo subscriptions ([pwython, 24.06.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48661315)); FLUX.3 Klein surprisingly worse than Z-Image Turbo ([vunderba, 17.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50127055)).
**M5 Max 128 GB with mflux**: about 1.4–1.5 s per step at 1024², so about 12–14 s per image ([fxd0h, 03.10.2026](https://github.com/mflux-community/mflux/issues/817)).
